installation.script:
#!/bin/bash

apt update
apt install -y zip unzip wget curl jq

if [ ! -d /mnt/server/ ]; then
    mkdir /mnt/server/
fi

cd /mnt/server

if [ "${BEDROCK_VERSION_TYPE}" == "custom" ] && [ -n "${BEDROCK_VERSION_CUSTOM}" ]; then
    BEDROCK_VERSION="${BEDROCK_VERSION_CUSTOM}"
else
    BEDROCK_VERSION="${BEDROCK_VERSION_TYPE}"
fi

if [ "${BEDROCK_VERSION_TYPE}" == "custom" ]; then
    case "${BEDROCK_VERSION}" in
        1.26.5[1-9]*|1.26.[6-9]*|1.2[7-9]*|1.[3-9]*|2.*) ;;
        *) echo -e "WARNING: custom version ${BEDROCK_VERSION} is below 1.26.51 - NetherNet behind Docker/NAT needs 1.26.51 or newer (1.26.50.x cannot open gameplay sockets). Consider latest instead.";;
    esac
fi

if [ -z "${BEDROCK_VERSION}" ] || [ "${BEDROCK_VERSION}" == "latest" ]; then
    echo -e "\n Fetching latest Bedrock server URL from API"
    DOWNLOAD_URL=$(curl -s https://net-secondary.web.minecraft-services.net/api/v1.0/download/links | jq -r '.result.links[] | select(.downloadType == "serverBedrockLinux") | .downloadUrl')
elif [ "${BEDROCK_VERSION}" == "preview" ]; then
    echo -e "\n Fetching latest Bedrock Preview server URL from API"
    DOWNLOAD_URL=$(curl -s https://net-secondary.web.minecraft-services.net/api/v1.0/download/links | jq -r '.result.links[] | select(.downloadType == "serverBedrockPreviewLinux") | .downloadUrl')
else
    echo -e "\n Downloading ${BEDROCK_VERSION} Bedrock server"
    DOWNLOAD_URL="https://www.minecraft.net/bedrockdedicatedserver/bin-linux/bedrock-server-$BEDROCK_VERSION.zip"
fi

DOWNLOAD_FILE=${DOWNLOAD_URL##*/}

if [ -z "$DOWNLOAD_URL" ] || [ "$DOWNLOAD_URL" = "null" ]; then
    echo -e "Failed to get download URL. Aborting."
    exit 1
fi

echo -e "backing up config files"
rm -rf *.bak keys.bak versions.html.gz 2>/dev/null
cp server.properties server.properties.bak 2>/dev/null
cp permissions.json permissions.json.bak 2>/dev/null
cp allowlist.json allowlist.json.bak 2>/dev/null
cp -r keys keys.bak 2>/dev/null

echo -e "Downloading files from: $DOWNLOAD_URL"

curl -L -A "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36" -H "Accept-Language: en" -o $DOWNLOAD_FILE $DOWNLOAD_URL

echo -e "Unpacking server files"
unzip -o $DOWNLOAD_FILE

echo -e "Cleaning up after installing"
rm -f $DOWNLOAD_FILE

echo -e "restoring backup config files - on first install there will be file not found errors which you can ignore."
cp -rf server.properties.bak server.properties 2>/dev/null
cp -rf permissions.json.bak permissions.json 2>/dev/null
cp -rf allowlist.json.bak allowlist.json 2>/dev/null
if [ -d keys.bak ]; then rm -rf keys; cp -r keys.bak keys; fi 2>/dev/null

if [ ! -f keys/server_identity_key.pem ]; then
    if command -v openssl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo -e "generating server identity key (players will not need to re-accept server trust after reinstalls)"
        mkdir -p keys
        openssl ecparam -name secp384r1 -genkey -noout -out keys/server_identity_key.pem 2>/dev/null
        chmod 600 keys/server_identity_key.pem 2>/dev/null
    else
        echo -e "openssl not available, skipping server identity key generation"
    fi
fi

chmod +x bedrock_server

echo -e "Install Completed"

variables.name: Bedrock Version
variables.description: Select the version type to install.

variables.name: Custom Version
variables.description: Specify an exact version (e.g. 1.26.33.2). Only used when Bedrock Version is set to "custom".

variables.name: ld lib path
variables.description: Dumb reasons to need this

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: The name for the server

variables.name: Gamemode
variables.description: Allowed values: "survival", "creative", or "adventure"

variables.name: Difficulty
variables.description: Allowed values: "peaceful", "easy", "normal", or "hard"

variables.name: Allow cheats
variables.description:
If true then cheats like commands can be used.

Allowed values: "true" or "false"

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Maximum number of players that can join the server.

variables.name: Online Mode
variables.description: If true, players must have a Microsoft/Xbox account to join. Set to false for offline/LAN play.

variables.name: Render Distance
variables.description: Maximum view distance in chunks. Lower values improve performance.

variables.name: Force Gamemode
variables.description: If true, players are always forced to the default gamemode on join.

variables.name: Tick Distance
variables.description: Simulation distance in chunks. Controls how far entities and redstone are processed.

variables.name: Texture Pack Required
variables.description: If true, players must accept the server's resource pack to join. It also prevents players from using their own global resource packs while connected to the server.

variables.name: Network Transport
variables.description: Network transport used to accept client connections. NetherNet (WebRTC) is the current default; switch to RakNet only for old clients that cannot connect otherwise.

variables.name: NetherNet UDP Ports (Advanced Override)
variables.description: ADVANCED OVERRIDE: complete server-udp-ports value, takes precedence over the split Public IP / External Ports / Internal Ports variables below. Prefer the split variables; use this only for multi-entry or unusual mappings. Leave empty unless overriding. Ignored when Transport is raknet.

variables.name: IPv6 Port
variables.description: IPv6 gameplay port. Only used when Transport is raknet (ignored under nethernet, which opens a single dual-stack socket on the main port). Needs its own panel allocation to be reachable.

variables.name: LAN Visibility
variables.description: Respond to clients looking for servers on the LAN. Turn off on shared hosts or multi-server nodes to avoid port conflicts (under RakNet the server binds 19132/19133 for discovery even with custom ports).

variables.name: NetherNet Public IP
variables.description: Public address clients use to reach this server (the ip: prefix of the NetherNet port mapping). Required together with External/Internal Ports behind Docker or NAT, otherwise clients are handed unreachable container addresses. Leave empty for ephemeral mode or directly-connected hosts.

variables.name: NetherNet External Ports
variables.description: Client-facing UDP port or inclusive range advertised to players (e.g. 32100-32149). Must be open in the firewall and have one panel allocation per port on panel hosts. Requires Public IP and Internal Ports; leave all three empty for ephemeral mode.

variables.name: NetherNet Internal Ports
variables.description: Container-local UDP port or inclusive range BDS binds (e.g. 32100-32149). Must be the same length as External Ports; ports pair by offset. With 1:1 panel allocations use the same range for both. Leave empty for ephemeral mode.
